'''Jomun Litas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]], and was welcome on the [[House Thul (estate)|estate]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]-allied [[House of Thul|House Thul]].

==Behind the scenes==
Litas appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as an Equipment Commendations Vendor for Imperial players on Alderaan.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Jomun Litas was removed from the game along with the rest of the Equipment Commendations Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]], which labeled him as "Jomun Litas."<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
